projectDesc.p: This transcription was made by the International Greek New Testament Project in its work towards the Editio Critica Maior.

editorialDecl.p: Scanned monochrome microfilm images were used for the transcription from the Library of Congress website; those on NTVMR are overexposed and in one or more cases corrupted.
This transcription was produced in plain text, using unicode, and converted by Hugh Houghton and Catherine Smith using the project's legacy conversion scripts in October 2018.
The XML specifications used are version 1.6 of the IGNTP Guidelines available at
